impact: All 39 tests in app/Modules/TaskRunner/Tests/Commands/TaskRunCommandTest.php invoke task:run with a stored Task id or name (['id' => $task->id]) and assert output like 'Running task: Test Task' and 'Task not found'. The real command's only argument is {cmd : Command to run} - it runs an arbitrary command string and reports 'Running task: <name-or-cmd>' from the --name option. Verified against the full history of the file: {cmd} is the only argument the signature has ever declared, so this is not drift from a rename, and no capability was lost. The tests describe a different command: 're-run a task recorded in the database'. Decide which is wanted - implement re-run (a real feature, e.g. task:run --id=<id>), or rewrite the file to cover the command that exists. Do not rename the arguments: the assertions would still be testing behaviour the command does not have. task:show in the same directory WAS a plain argument-name mismatch and was fixed in ISS-010.
title: TaskRunCommandTest tests a re-run-a-stored-task command that has never existed
